generated-dog-skins.reference_time_range: cartoon interpretations from user-approved mappings; no footage frame extraction
generated-dog-skins.notes: Generated cartoon artwork; Haohazi replaces Huanghuang as peashooter, Xiaobao maps to wallnut, and Xiaodu maps to jalapeno. Aoaoao remains the red-vest zombie. These assets do not claim photographic likeness.
generated-dog-skins.derivation: Six-column, four-row 256px source sheets plus user-approved identity-based cartoon adaptations; fixed foot baseline and 2x pixel scale.

classic-ui-extracted.notes: Source describes main.pak extraction; asset ownership remains with original creators.

generated-classic-plants.notes: Original generated cartoon game character sheets; not photographs or extracted original-game art. High-density source frames are included in assets/skins/default/source.

user-dog-animation-sheets.notes: The updated 005 photo skin adds Haohazi as peashooter. Original source sheets are preserved unchanged; derived frames identify their source indexes.

user-dog-animation-sheets-005.derivation: dogs_photo uses cleaned photo poses; dogs uses a deterministic cartoon adaptation. Original PNG files remain unchanged.

generated-background-005.author: Plants vs Zombies project contributors
